## Run identity and interpretation

**Mode: `r run$mode`**. Configured model: **`r run$config$openai$model`**.
Started (UTC): `r run$started_at`.

```{r fixture-banner, results='asis'}
if (run$mode == "offline_fixture") {
  cat('<div class="alert alert-warning"><strong>OFFLINE FIXTURE RUN.</strong> ',
      'These designs are deterministic software fixtures, not OpenAI-generated findings.</div>')
}
```

One experiment per scenario and no additional validation draws. The results below
are realized FDP, false-discovery indicators, and power. They are **not estimates
of FWER or FDR**, and cannot certify an agent's statistical guarantee.

The transfer cycle is 1 → 2, 2 → 3, 3 → 1. Testing uses alpha/3; sample-size
planning uses the specified one-sided Bonferroni threshold alpha/m. The z-test
reference uses the known generator variance, which is withheld from agents.

```{r baseline-policy, results='asis'}
methods <- run$config$baseline_fdr_methods
if (!is.null(methods)) {
  cat('FDR baseline corrections: **', paste(methods, collapse = ', '),
      '**, in priority order. Method IDs ending in `_bh` use BH; those ending ',
      'in `_by` use BY. FWER baselines use Holm.\n\n', sep = '')
} else {
  cat('Legacy baseline policy: Holm for FWER and BY for FDR.\n\n')
}
```

## Realized outcomes across three target groups

Incomplete methods have no global FDP, power, or false-discovery indicator.
Different scenarios are not pooled into an estimated error rate.

```{r global-table}
knitr::kable(global, digits = 4)
```

```{r power-plot, out.width='100%'}
if (file.exists(file.path(run_dir, "power.png"))) knitr::include_graphics(file.path(run_dir, "power.png"), rel_path = FALSE)
```

## Frozen scientific explanations

The following explanations are escaped text. No agent-provided report is executed
as R Markdown or interpreted as raw HTML.

```{r explanations, results='asis'}
for (entry in reports) {
  cat('<h3>', escape_html(entry$label), '</h3><pre>', escape_html(entry$text), '</pre>\n')
}
```

## Reproduction

The run directory contains resolved configuration, R session details, planning
data, frozen SHA-256 manifests, prompts, conversations, execution logs, and
per-hypothesis CSV results. Private generator data never enters agent containers.
Use `scripts/render_report.R --run-dir <directory>` to rebuild this report without
API calls. Use `scripts/run_pilot.R --resume --run-dir <directory>` with the
matching live/offline mode to reuse valid completed designs.
